Method and limitations

Landsat: 25 June 2026. Neuwerk excluded from analysis.
Equal weights: ⅓ park distance, ⅓ low greenness, ⅓ heat.
Alternative: ½ park distance, ¼ low greenness, ¼ heat.

Distance is measured from cell centres to mapped parks in a straight line. Temperature refers to land surface, not air temperature.

Exploratory screening, not approved planting sites. Ownership, existing land use and feasibility require review. Unassessed areas are not necessarily low priority.

Sources: Hamburg district and park data; USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2.
